test.result: 69 passed (exit code 0) across Kite event normalization, historical Kite ingestion, raw quote archive, and live intraday runner tests. Ruff and mypy passed for changed Python modules; source inventory and capability evidence checks passed.

implemented: Kite event normalization never substitutes receipt time for a missing source timestamp; malformed/missing timestamps are rejected or durably reason-coded.
Received events explicitly reject source timestamps in the future, record source timestamp age, and support a caller-supplied non-negative source-specific maximum age.
The legacy live Kite poll loop now pins a configurable 30-second source-age tolerance by default and durably routes stale quote rows to its rejection sink instead of the forward event sink.
The legacy paper strategy path also excludes quotes with missing, malformed, future, or over-tolerance packet timestamps before market state or price decisions are updated.
Tests cover source-age tolerance, future source clocks, missing/invalid timestamps, source-local naive Kite timestamps, and reversed ingest/receipt clocks.
blockers: The provider timestamp's exact semantics can vary between last trade time and quote/depth capture time; policy must account for feed type before this becomes a universal fill gate.
scope_note: A configurable 30-second default is enforced for forward event capture and legacy paper decisions. Kite timestamp semantics and empirical freshness/latency still require provider-specific and prospective validation.
